newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile pension funds post June returns of 2.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile pension funds post June returns of 2.8 pct.

text.p: Chile's private pension funds reported returns on assets of 2.8 percent in June, bringing returns for the first six months of the year to 8.6 percent, said the Pension Fund Managers Superintendency.
The strong June figure reflects the rally in the stock market last month, especially the run-up in electricity shares, the superintendency said in a report.
The heavyweight power sector accounts for 14 percent of the system's overall investment.
Electricity investments were follow in terms of profitability by investments in services, natural resources and industrial stocks.
Investments in fixed income -- 59 percent of the system's total investments -- and in financial intermediation gave returns of 0.36 percent in June.
Private pension funds controlled assets worth $32.3 billion at the end of June, up nearly 14 percent from the same month in 1996.
